name: THCA Prerolls - Big Bombers - Rainbow Belts - 4 Grams
description:
Description

Rainbow Belts THCA Prerolls

Indulge in the soothing effects of our Rainbow Belts Indica THCA Prerolls, featuring two 2G glass-tipped prerolls enriched with THCA diamonds and CBG kief for maximum potency. This indica offers a calming aroma with sweet, fruity undertones, leading to a deeply relaxing and euphoric experience. Perfect for unwinding after a long day, each preroll promises smooth, rich puffs and a luxurious escape.

Details

• Rainbow Belts (Indica) Premium Hemp Flower

• 4 Grams (Two 2G Prerolls)

• Glass Tips

• Dipped in THCA Diamonds + CBG Kief

• 100% Hemp-Derived

Suggested Use

Ignite and inhale. If you're new to THC, try a few hits to see how you feel and dose accordingly from there for desired effect.

Cannabinoids

• THCA

• Delta-8 THC

• CBG

• CBD

What is THCA?

THCA Is The Precursor To THC

This enigmatic cannabinoid holds immense potential, offering a multitude of therapeutic benefits. THCA, the precursor to THC, is a cannabinoid found in the hemp plant that converts to Delta-9 when decarboxylated (heated). When combined with other cannabinoids, such as Delta-8, the results will leave you feeling a sense of calm.

What is Delta-8?

Delta-8 is made from pure CBD

 Delta-8, the godfather molecule of the industry, offers a user-friendly experience that is similar to Delta-9. It's perfect for inexperienced consumers and referred to by us as "diet weed" because of its softer effects on the body and mind while providing all the benefits of actual cannabis. Delta-8 is made from pure CBD isolate and is another magical gift from these amazing hemp plants.

What is CBG?

CBG AKA Mother Of All Cannabinoids

CBG (cannabigerol) the “Mother of All Cannabinoids” is a non-psychoactive and non-intoxicating derivative that breaks down to form other cannabinoids such as CBD and THC. CBG interacts with the body's endocannabinoid system, which regulates various physiological functions and possesses potential therapeutic benefits.

What is CBD?

CBD is Non-Psychoactive

CBD (Cannabidiol) is a naturally occurring compound found in the hemp plant that’s non-psychoactive. It has been shown to have a variety of potential health benefits, including relieving pain, reducing anxiety, and improving sleep.

THCA Disclaimer

This product is not available for shipment to the following states: Hawaii, Idaho, Minnesota, Oregon, Rhode Island, Utah, and Vermont.
